change: AutoSync can now dial an explicit multiaddr through the new JNI entry nativeDialAddressOnce; the loopback port path is kept for same-device sync
why: the previous dial API always connected to 127.0.0.1, so a background sync could never reach a peer on the LAN

evidence.build: sync library cross-compiled for aarch64-linux-android and packaged
evidence.probe: AUTO_SYNC_PROBE outcome=completed with probe-3b191927e58a5071 applied=1 cursor=127.0.0.1:47960 ok:1

limitations: the probe still uses a loopback address, so the LAN branch is compiled but not exercised against a remote host
a stored address only becomes a multiaddr after a manual sync records one; discovery does not yet write it
